title: Orsen and the Vector
author: Elodie Dravenmoor
blurb: August Winterbourne, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
